method.p95: nearest rank; small paired sample, descriptive only
method.ratios: median baseline divided by median candidate; never multiplied
method.warmups: one untimed paired parity pass except graph scenarios
method.setup: described separately per workload; no artificial sleeps

comparisons.name: legacy_topic_loop_vs_r10_verified_batch
limitations: Legacy repeated scans do not verify the memory checkpoint.
R10 verifies once and retains existing per-coordinate topic queries.
Synthetic reviews affect ordering only; topic candidates remain unreviewed.

comparisons.name: r10_verified_memory_vs_beast20_batched_topic_views
limitations: Baseline is the current optimized R10 verified memory API, not the older raw scans.
BEAST20 additionally verifies at return and uses bounded topic SQL batches.
Authorization callbacks are local test callbacks, not live host authentication.

comparisons.name: gf8_uncached_vs_cold_batch_physics_reuse
limitations: Exact reasoning-packet parity includes per-coordinate receipts.
Reuse is valid only for identical physics inputs; changing a material/drive changes the key.
Local analytic CPU model; no physical acoustic processor, GPT inference or hosted latency.
Candidate timing includes a fresh in-memory store and runtime per batch.

comparisons.name: gf8_uncached_vs_prepopulated_physics_reuse
limitations: Exact reasoning-packet parity includes per-coordinate receipts.
Reuse is valid only for identical physics inputs; changing a material/drive changes the key.
Local analytic CPU model; no physical acoustic processor, GPT inference or hosted latency.
Candidate cache is prepopulated before timing.

comparisons.name: source_objects_individual_vs_bounded_batch_get
limitations: Both paths verify exact bytes against SHA-256.
Source insertion/setup is excluded from retrieval timing.

comparisons.name: source_names_preparsed_linear_vs_persistent_inverted_index
limitations: Baseline tokens are already parsed; this is a competitive in-memory linear baseline.
Persistent index additionally retrieves and verifies source bytes/metadata.
Output comparison uses exact ordered IDs/scores; no semantic-relevance improvement is inferred.
SQLite overhead can make the indexed route slower for a small or broad-query corpus.

comparisons.name: full_cascade_rebuild_vs_verified_job_reuse
limitations: Jobs are actual source-text/digest reductions, not model calls or resident turns.
Synchronous CPU handlers do not gain multicore parallelism from asyncio.
Timings include task construction, integrity checks, scheduling and checkpoint operations.
Each baseline uses a fresh in-memory checkpoint DB.

comparisons.name: full_rebuild_vs_one_node_supplement_change
limitations: Jobs are actual source-text/digest reductions, not model calls or resident turns.
Synchronous CPU handlers do not gain multicore parallelism from asyncio.
Timings include task construction, integrity checks, scheduling and checkpoint operations.
Supplemental computation input changes; original source bytes and CANON stay fixed.
Each pair uses a never-before-seen supplement revision; cache reuse cannot hide updates.

functional_observations.name: persistent_cascade_restart
functional_observations.limitation: One functional restart observation, not a paired latency speedup claim.

claim_limits: No hosted authorization, model-quality, physical cymatics or universal superiority measurement.
Cold setup and full-source invalidation remain real costs.
Negative results are retained; source text is not included in this report.
